# RPLT USA

> RPLT USA (https://rpltusa.com) is a one page guide to lab tested research peptides for US researchers. Every listed peptide is 99% purity or higher and ships with a Certificate of Analysis. Orders are placed, processed and shipped by ProLongevity Peptides (https://prolongevitypeptide.com), the official store. Free US shipping on orders over $150. All products are for laboratory research use only and are not for human consumption.

## Featured peptides

Tirzepatide, Semaglutide, BPC-157, GHK-Cu, Tesamorelin, TB-500, CJC-1295 with DAC / Ipamorelin, MOTS-c, AOD-9604, Ipamorelin and Epithalon. Live prices and vial sizes are on https://rpltusa.com/#best-sellers and the full 22 peptide catalog is at https://prolongevitypeptide.com/products.html.
